spans.s: प्रति—नगरम् ind. in every town, Hcar.
प्रति—नदि ind. at every river, Bālar.
प्रति—नप्तृ m. a great grandson, a son's grandson, L. (cf. प्रणपात्).
प्रति—नमस्कार mfn. one who returns a salutation, ŚāṅkhŚr.
प्रति—नयन (ibc.), into the eye, Mālatīm.
प्रति—नव mfn. new, young, fresh
प्रति—नव—जवा-पुष्प n. a newly opened China rose, Megh.
प्रति—नाग m. = -कुञ्जर, MBh.
प्रति—नाडी f. a branch vein, L.
प्र॑ति—नामन् (प्र॑ति-), mf(म्नी)n. having corresponding names, related by name, ŚBr.
प्रति—ना˚म , ind. by n˚, mentioning the n˚, Veṇīs.
प्रति—ना˚म—ग्रहणम् (प्र॑ति-) ind. mentioning each individual n˚, Kād.
प्रति—नायक m. ‘counter hero’, the adversary of the hero (in a play), Sāh.
an image, likeness, counterfeit, Śrīkaṇṭh.
प्रति-˚नायक See p. 662, col. 1.
प्रति—नारी f. a female rival, Śiś.
प्रति—निशम् ind. every night, Kathās.
प्रति—निश्चय m. a contrary opinion, MBh.
प्रति—निष्क m. or n. (?) a Niṣka (s.v.) in each case, Hcat.
प्रति—निष्ठ mfn. standing on the opposite side, Car.
प्रति—नृपति m. = -क्षोणिभृत्, Dhanaṃj.
प्रति—न्याय॑म् ind. in inverted order, ŚBr.
प्रति—न्यास a counter deposit, Nār.
प्रति-˚न्यास See p. 662, col. 1.
प्रति—न्यूङ्ख m. a corresponding insertion of the vowel ओ, ŚāṅkhŚr.
प्रति—न्यूङ्˚खय Nom. ˚यति, to insert the vowel ओ in the corresponding stanza or verse, ib.

प्रति-√ नद् P. -नदति, to sound back, answer with a cry or shout, MBh.; R. &c.:
Caus. -नादयति, to cause to resound, make resonant, fill with cries, ib.
प्रति-˚नाद m. echo, reverberation, Kād.
प्रति-˚नादित mfn. (fr. Caus.) filled with sounds, resonant, echoing or echoed, Hariv.; R.
प्रति-˚निनद m. = ˚नाद, Kir.
प्रति-˚नन्द m. N. of a poet, Cat.
प्रति-˚न॑न्दन n. greeting, salutation, friendly acceptance, AV.
thanksgiving, MW.
प्रति-˚नन्दित mfn. saluted or accepted kindly or cheerfully, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्रति-√ नम् (only pf. -नानाम), to bow or incline towards (acc.), RV.
प्रति-√ नर्द् P. Ā. -नर्दति, ˚ते, to roar or cry against or after (food), greet or hail with cries, MBh.; Hariv.
, see कर्णप्र्˚ and cf. प्रती-नाह under 1. प्रती, p. 673.
प्रती—नाह m. (cf. प्रति-न्˚, p. 666, col. 2) obstruction, constipation, Car.; Suśr.
a flag, banner, ŚBr.
प्रति-निः-√ सृज् P. -सृजति, to drive towards, give up to (dat.), ŚBr.
प्रति-˚निःसर्ग m. giving back, abandonment, Lalit. (w.r. निःसङ्ग).
प्रति-˚निःसृज्य mfn. to be given up or abandoned, L.
प्रति-˚निःसृष्ट mfn. driven away, Divyāv.
प्रति-नि-√ क्षिप् P. -क्षिपति, to put down or deposit again, MBh.

प्रति-नि-√ गद् P. -गदति, to speak to, address, KātyŚr.;
to recite or repeat singly, TBr., Sch.
प्रति-नि-√ ग्रह् Ā. -गृह्णीते, to take up (liquids), ladle out, ŚBr.
प्रति-˚निग्राह्य mfn. to be ladled out, ĀpŚr. (cf. ˚निर्ग्र्˚).
प्रति-˚निधातव्य mfn. to be substituted, Nyāyam., Sch.
प्रति-˚निधापयितव्य mfn. to be caused to be substituted, ib.
प्रति-˚निधि m. substitution
a substitute, representative, proxy, surety, ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a resemblance of a real form, an image, likeness, statue, picture, Kāv.
(ifc.) an image of i.e. similar, like, Kāvyād. (˚धी-√ कृ, to substitute anything [acc.] for [comp.] MBh.; Ragh.)
प्रति-˚निधेय mfn. to be substituted, Nyāyam.
प्रति-√ निन्द् P. -निन्दति, to abuse, blame, censure, MBh.
falling down, alighting, MBh.
fixed or adopted for each single case, particular or different for each case, Kap.; Śaṃk.
प्रति-˚नियम m. a strict rule as to applying an example to particular persons or things only, Kap.
प्रति-निर्-√ अस् P. -अस्यति, to throw back, ĀpŚr.
to be taken up with a ladle, ĀpŚr. (cf. प्रति-निग्र्˚).
appropriated, turned to one's own advantage, MBh.
प्रति-निर्-√ दिश् (only Pass. -दिश्यते), to point or refer back, Kāś. on Pāṇ. i, 2, 53.
प्रति-˚निर्दिष्ट mfn. referred to again, KātyŚr., Sch.
प्रति-˚निर्देश m. a reference back to (with gen.), renewed mention, Śaṃk.
प्रति-˚निर्देशक mfn. pointing or referring back (ifc.), KātyŚr., Sch.
प्रति-˚निर्देश्य mfn. referred to or mentioned again, Sāh.
प्रति-निर्-√ यत् Caus. -यातयति, to give back, return, MBh.
प्रति-˚निर्यातन n. giving back, returning, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 11, Sch.
rewarding, retaliation, L.
प्रति-निर्-√ या P. -याति, to come forth again, MBh.; MārkP.
प्रति-निर्-√ वप् P. -वपति, to distribute in return, TS.; TBr.; Kauś.
keeping off, warding off, BhP.
a kind of garment, Buddh.
quite prepossessed with (loc.), R.
obstinate, obdurate
प्रति-नि-विष्ट—मूर्ख m. an obstinate fool, Bhartṛ.
प्रति-˚निवेश m. obstinacy, obdurateness, Baudh.
प्रति-नि-√ वृत् Ā. -वर्तते (
प्रति-˚निवर्तन n. returning, coming back (see पुनः-प्र्˚).
प्रति-˚निवर्तित mfn. (fr. Caus.) caused to return, led back, R.
प्रति-˚निवृत्त mfn. turned back or from (abl.), come back, return, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्रति-˚निवृत्ति f. coming back, return, ĀpŚr., Sch.
retaliation, retribution, L.
प्रति-निष्-√ पू P. -पुनाति, to cleanse or winnow again, purify, KātyŚr.; Kauś.; Suśr.
प्रति-निष्-˚पूत mfn. cleansed, winnowed, Suśr.
प्रति-निस्-√ तॄ P. -तरति, to accomplish, Divyāv.
प्रति-नि-√ हन् (only 2. pers. pf. -जघ॑न्थ), to aim a blow at (acc.), RV. i, 52, 15.
प्रति-˚निहत mfn. hit, slain, killed, MBh.

प्रति-√ नी P. -नयति, to lead towards or back, AV. &c. &c.;
to put into, mix, Kauś.
प्रति-√ नु P. -नौति, to commend, approve, Pat.
प्रति-√ नुद् P. Ā. -नुदति, ˚ते, to thrust back, repulse, ward off, RV.; VS.; TS.; Br.
प्रति-˚नोद m. thrusting back, repulse, TāṇḍBr. (cf. अ॑-प्र्˚).

प्रति-√ नृत् P. -नृत्यति, to dance before (in token of contempt), mock in turn by dancing before (acc.), MBh. :
Intens. -नर्नृतीति, to dance before (in token of love), delight or gladden by dancing before (acc.), Pat.
प्रति-न्य्-√ अस् (only ind.p. -न्यस्य), to place apart or lay down separately (for different persons), deposit, R. (v.l. प्र-वि-न्˚).
प्रति-न्य्-आ-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to come back, return, Kāṭh.
प्रती—नाह—भाजन n. that which represents a b˚, ib.
N. of a prince of Videha, R.
(प्रति-√ इन्व्) P. प्रतीन्वति, to urge, promote, advance, RV. i, 54, 7.
प्राति—निधिक m. (fr. -निधि) a substitute, KātyŚr.
